title: An early specialized sound-medium field ontology in Vaiśeṣika
author: Arjun Shah

items.excerpt: dharmaviśeṣa prasūtāt dravyaguṇakarmasāmānya viśeṣasamavāyānāṃ padārthānāṃ sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāṃ tattvajñānānniḥśreyasam
pratyakṣapravṛttatvāt saṃjñākarmaṇaḥ paratra samavāyāt pratyakṣatvācca nātmaguṇo na manoguṇaḥ

detail: Kaṇāda’s ākāśa–śabda exclusivity is fully attested (9/9) in primary Sanskrit. On a shared 6-feature rubric, only Vaiśeṣika scores R2=1 (sound specially tied to the pervasive medium). Greek atomism/Platonism and Maxwell EM all score R2=0. Historically impressive specialized medium theory; not Maxwell; not Capra quantum.
isef_angle: Under-researched comparative history-of-physics result: classical India formalized a pervasive medium whose defining mark is sound, while separating light/heat — a structural move Greek atomism and modern EM do not share.
